name: exercism-polyglot
title: Exercism Polyglot
summary: Programming exercises in C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python and Rust. The AI solves each one so that all its tests pass.
description: Each test task gives the AI an exercise as Exercism ships it, with its instructions, starting files and tests. The AI writes the solution. It passes when every test of the exercise passes, run without internet access.
